description: This file defines routes for user-related operations in an Express server, including registration, login, profile management, appointments, and payments.

methods.name: POST /register
methods.description: Handles user registration by invoking registerUser controller.

methods.name: POST /login
methods.description: Handles user login by invoking loginUser controller.

methods.name: GET /get-profile
methods.description: Retrieves user profile, protected by authUser middleware.

methods.name: POST /update-profile
methods.description: Updates user profile with optional image upload, protected by authUser and multer middleware.

methods.name: POST /book-appointment
methods.description: Books an appointment, protected by authUser.

methods.name: GET /appointments
methods.description: Lists user's appointments, protected by authUser.

methods.name: POST /cancel-appointment
methods.description: Cancels an appointment, protected by authUser.

methods.name: POST /payment-razorpay
methods.description: Processes Razorpay payment, protected by authUser.

methods.name: POST /verifyRazorpay
methods.description: Verifies Razorpay payment, protected by authUser.

methods.name: POST /payment-stripe
methods.description: Processes Stripe payment, protected by authUser.

methods.name: POST /verifyStripe
methods.description: Verifies Stripe payment, protected by authUser.
